shots.name: 1 · Medium A
shots.purpose: she listens; the stairwell is dark behind her
shots.why: A medium shot is the conversational distance: body language and face together, nothing forced. The 28mm wide lens exaggerates depth, so the space around the subject becomes part of the drama. Wide-ish lenses and negative space invite scanning; short-siding plants the threat zone; slow push-ins on emptiness let imagination do the work; withholding the face transfers her fear to the viewer. Rule: frame them short-sided with a dark doorway or corridor in the open side of the frame, because the open side is where the viewer expects the threat; the eye keeps checking it.
alternatives: Avoid bright even lighting: nothing left to hide.
